summary: Maintenance release of the 5.38 line. Meeting join links become mandatory, PostgreSQL storage is available for custom backends, login budgets, DPoP nonces and connections, and team admins can resend verification emails. Before deploying: if galley.config.postgresMigration.conversationCodes is still cassandra, move it to migration-to-postgresql, or meetings fail with 500 link-unavailable.

changes.description: Every meeting now has a join link backed by a live join code, and meeting join codes are only stored in PostgreSQL. With galley.config.postgresMigration.conversationCodes on cassandra (the chart default), creating a meeting or refreshing its link fails with 500 link-unavailable, and so do reads of meetings that have no live join code, on every API version. Before upgrading, set conversationCodes to migration-to-postgresql (dual-write, guest links stay on Cassandra) or postgresql, and keep a join-link URI configured (galley settings.conversationCodeURI, or the domain of the user in settings.multiIngress).

From client API version 19 every meeting carries its join link: a one-off data migration gives each existing meeting without a live join code a canonical one, without rotating existing codes, and replaces the periodic galley backfill. Refreshing a meeting link reports has_password according to the password supplied with the refresh.

PostgreSQL storage for custom backends, login budgets, DPoP nonces and connections, opt-in through the new galley.config.postgresMigration keys customBackend, budget, nonce and connections (cassandra by default). Custom backends, nonces and connections are backfilled by background-worker (migrateCustomBackend, migrateNonce, migrateConnections); budgets have no backfill, so keep budget on migration-to-postgresql for at least the longest limitFailedLogins.timeout before switching to postgresql. Follow the migration pattern of the configuration options documentation.

PUT /teams/{tid}/members/{uid}/verification-email lets a team admin resend the verification email of a member whose email address is still unverified: 202 when an email is sent, 204 when there is nothing to verify.

Mock endpoints for TOTP (RFC 6238) second factors from client API version 19: POST /self/totp, POST /self/totp/{id}/activate, GET /self/totp, PUT /self/totp/{id} and DELETE /self/totp/{id}. They parse the request and return generated data; nothing is stored and no code is checked. nginz routes them without OAuth scopes.

Federation error responses include federation_domain, the requested peer, and, when an SRV target is known, srv_target and srv_target_domain. The domain and path fields are unchanged. Federation error logs carry the same information.
nginx-ingress-services: the federator ingress only exposes paths under /federation instead of every path of the federator.
Gundeck exports new Prometheus metrics on stored pushes (wire_push_stored_*), notification fetches (wire_notification_fetch*) and websocket deliveries (wire_push_ws_delivered_presences*).
Re-joining an MLS group with an external commit could drop the client from the member list kept by the backend, silently stopping message delivery to that client.
Legacy team 1:1 conversations are excluded from the prevention of admin-less groups.

migrations.description: If galley.config.postgresMigration.conversationCodes is cassandra, set it to migration-to-postgresql (or postgresql once the conversation codes are migrated) and check that settings.conversationCodeURI or settings.multiIngress is set in galley.
SQL migration 20261019090000-meeting-join-code-backfill gives every meeting without a live join code a canonical one. It runs once per database at service startup and never rotates an existing code.
migrations.order: at startup, before meetings are served

migrations.description: SQL migrations create the PostgreSQL tables of the budget, connections, custom backend and nonce stores. They stay unused while the matching postgresMigration keys are cassandra.

configuration.description: The default is unchanged, but meetings now need meeting join codes in PostgreSQL: set migration-to-postgresql or postgresql, otherwise meetings fail with 500 link-unavailable.
Storage of custom backends: cassandra, migration-to-postgresql or postgresql. Mandatory in the brig, galley and background-worker configuration; the chart renders the default.
Storage of login budgets (rate-limit counters). No backfill: stay on migration-to-postgresql for at least the longest limitFailedLogins.timeout before switching to postgresql.
Storage of DPoP replay nonces: cassandra, migration-to-postgresql or postgresql.
Storage of user connections: cassandra, migration-to-postgresql or postgresql.
Starts the backfill of custom backends to PostgreSQL. Set postgresMigration.customBackend to migration-to-postgresql first.
Starts the backfill of DPoP nonces to PostgreSQL. Set postgresMigration.nonce to migration-to-postgresql first.
Starts the backfill of connections to PostgreSQL. Set postgresMigration.connections to migration-to-postgresql first.
